newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Fujitsu Systems stock suspended - KLSE.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu Systems stock suspended - KLSE.

text.p: Fujitsu Systems Business (M) Bhd's stock was suspended on Monday for a company announcement, an official at the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said.
Shares of the distributor of computers and computer products closed at 15.20 ringgit on Friday.
An exchange official said Fujitsu is expected to make an announcement before the market closes on Monday.
A Fujitsu spokesman would not comment on the contents of the announcement.
